_meta.instrument: Self-Assessment Worksheet on Risk Levels of Products, Services, and Features (PLF)
_meta.legal_source: Ministerial Decree (Kepmen) of the Ministry of Communications and Digital Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia No. 142 of 2026, Appendix II (Technical Guidelines for Risk Level Assessment Based on Aspects and Indicators), Chapters III and IV.
_meta.implements: Article 4(3) of Government Regulation (PP) No. 17/2025 (PP TUNAS); Articles 20 and 23 of Permen Komdigi No. 9/2026.
_meta.translation: Unofficial English translation ([BGA] UNOFFICIAL TRANSLATION). The Bahasa Indonesia text in the State Gazette is authoritative. Verify the full form against pages 85-87 of the regulation.
_meta.scoring_rule: Aspect Risk Score = sum over parameters in the aspect of (weight% x status), where status = 1 if the assessor marks the parameter in the weighted column and 0 otherwise. An aspect is HIGH RISK when its Aspect Risk Score > 50%. The PLF has a HIGH-RISK profile if AT LEAST ONE of the seven aspects exceeds 50%. The Director General makes the final determination after verification.
_meta.weight_column_note: Per the detailed parameter tables in Chapter III, the printed risk weight sits under YES/FOUND for risk-bearing technical configurations and under NO/NOT FOUND for protective configurations (where ABSENCE of the control is the risk). The 'weight_column' field records where the law prints the non-zero weight for each parameter. NOTE: the simplified worksheet instruction on the template page states 'where YES is selected the weight applies; where NO is selected the weight is 0' — this conflicts with the detailed tables for protective parameters. The detailed Chapter III tables are treated as authoritative here. Flag this tension to counsel.
_meta.weight_sum_note: In the authoritative text the parameter weights within each aspect should sum to 100%. In this unofficial translation aspects a-f sum to ~100% but aspect g (GF, physiological) sums to ~102% — a rounding/transcription artifact. Re-confirm the GF weights against the Bahasa Indonesia State Gazette text before relying on them.

parameters.indicator: Children's Accounts and/or Content are automatically recommended to other users based on the Child's profile.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has an Account recommendation feature that displays Children's user Accounts to other users and/or displays other users' Accounts to Children.

parameters.indicator: Children's Content is discoverable by unknown persons.
parameters.technical_configuration: Content Upload and Content Search or Discovery.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has features that enable users outside the PLF to discover and initiate contact with Child users through external search engines.

parameters.indicator: Children communicate or interact with unknown persons through the PLF, including communication in various forms.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has a Direct Messaging feature (e.g., direct message, private message) that may be used by Accounts that are not connected to each other.

parameters.indicator: Children's Content is discoverable by unknown persons.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has an Internal Search feature that displays Children's user Content to other users who are not connected to them.

parameters.indicator: Children's Content is discoverable by unknown persons.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has settings that enable Children's Content to be indexed by external search engines.

parameters.indicator: Children's Accounts are discoverable by unknown persons, and information regarding Children's Accounts or profiles is displayed within user profiles.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has an Internal Search feature that displays Children's Accounts to other users who are not connected to them.

parameters.indicator: The PLF may be configured by other persons to create forums, activities, or similar arrangements, enabling Children to communicate with unknown persons.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has group, forum, or shared activity space features that connect Child users with other users who are not connected to them.

parameters.indicator: Children communicate or interact with unknown persons through the PLF, including communication in various forms.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has features that enable message senders to delete and/or modify messages and attachments already received by Child users (e.g., unsend, delete for everyone, disappearing messages, edit after sending).

parameters.indicator: Children's Accounts are discoverable by unknown persons, and information regarding Children's Accounts or profiles is displayed within user profiles.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has settings that enable Children's user Accounts to be indexed and discovered by external search engines.

aspects.title: Exposure to pornographic, violent, life-endangering, and other Content not appropriate for Children

parameters.indicator: Automated provision of recommendations of inappropriate Content to Children based on Child profiles, including via AI.
parameters.technical_configuration: Recommendation, curation, and distribution of Content to Child Accounts.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF displays pornographic Content, violent Content, Content that endangers life or personal safety, or Content that is not age-appropriate to Child users.

parameters.indicator: The PLF may be configured to create forums/activities that connect or assemble Children and allow access to or transmission of inappropriate Content.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF enables Child users to be exposed to or access inappropriate Content through activity features, forums, or similar functionalities without age-based filtering.

parameters.indicator: Automated provision of recommendations of inappropriate Content to Children based on Child profiles, including via AI.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has Content recommendation features that utilize profiling of data and/or the behavior of Child users.

parameters.indicator: The PLF may enable other persons to communicate and transmit inappropriate Content to Children, or enable Children to access such Content.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has Direct Messaging features (e.g., direct messages, private messages) that enable the transmission of inappropriate Content to Child users without Content filtering.

parameters.indicator: Automated provision of recommendations of inappropriate Content to Children based on Child profiles, including via AI.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has Open Interaction features (e.g., comment sections, open forums) that enable Child users to receive and access inappropriate Content from other users without filtering.

parameters.indicator: Automated provision of recommendations of inappropriate Content to Children based on Child profiles, including via AI.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF provides features for blocking and reporting Content and other users.

parameters.indicator: The PLF enables the display of advertisements containing inappropriate Content.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF displays promotional Content containing pornographic, violent, life-endangering, or age-inappropriate Content to Child users.

parameters.indicator: Targeting of Children to offer goods and services by the ESO or cooperating parties (ads, paid content, etc.).
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has features that facilitate other parties to offer goods and/or services to Child users.

parameters.indicator: Targeting of Children to offer goods/services for the financial or commercial interests of the ESO.
parameters.technical_configuration: Offering of goods and/or services by the ESO.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has features that target Child users for the financial and/or business interests of third parties cooperating with the ESO.

parameters.indicator: Optimizing advertising performance, pricing, or sales strategies to increase profitability based on profiling of Children.
parameters.technical_configuration: Targeting Child users for particular purposes.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has features that target Child users for the financial and/or business interests of the ESO.

parameters.indicator: Targeting Children for the offering of goods/services by the ESO or cooperating parties (ads, paid content, etc.).
parameters.technical_configuration: User interface design and choice architecture (UI/UX), including mechanisms for consent, purchasing, and data sharing.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF employs Dark Patterns/Deceptive Design that direct Child users to take certain actions without full awareness (e.g., making purchases, subscribing, or sharing data).

parameters.indicator: Provision or facilitation of payment systems for the purchase of goods and services offered.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has payment features that enable Child users to purchase goods and/or services without parental or guardian verification.

parameters.indicator: Provision or operation of the PLF based on one-time or subscription-based payments.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has automatic subscription renewal features applicable to Child users without parental or guardian consent and/or verification.

parameters.indicator: Targeting Children for the offering of goods/services by the ESO or cooperating parties (ads, paid content, etc.).
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has features that involve Child users in activities that generate financial and/or business benefits for the ESO and/or third parties.

aspects.title: Threats to the security of Children's Personal Data

parameters.indicator: Child users are able to modify privacy settings without parental or guardian consent.
parameters.technical_configuration: Mechanisms for changing privacy settings on Child Accounts.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has privacy settings features that can be modified by Child users without parental or guardian consent.

parameters.indicator: Displaying the Personal Data of Child users to the public by default.
parameters.technical_configuration: Default privacy settings and visibility of Personal Data on Child Accounts.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has default settings that make the Personal Data of Child users publicly visible.

parameters.indicator: Development and implementation of security measures based on the nature and risk of Children's Personal Data.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF develops and implements data security measures based on the nature and risks of the Personal Data of Child users being processed.

parameters.indicator: Compliance with Personal Data Protection laws and regulations.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has a Personal Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) document as mandated under the Personal Data Protection Law.

parameters.indicator: Collection and/or processing of Children's user data without supervision from parents/guardians.
parameters.technical_configuration: Data collection and processing mechanisms and consent systems on Child accounts.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has mechanisms for the collection and/or processing of Children's user data that operate without parental/guardian supervision mechanisms.

parameters.indicator: Compliance with Personal Data Protection laws and regulations.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF provides a Personal Data Protection Notice (Privacy Notice) that is easily understood by Child users and their parents/guardians before the Child user registers.

parameters.indicator: Development and implementation of security measures based on the nature and risks of Children's Personal Data.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has designated personnel/officers who carry out the Personal Data Protection function (Data Protection Officer/DPO).

parameters.indicator: Design.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has an immersive design that causes Child users to be deeply and continuously engaged (e.g., full-screen display, minimal pauses or time indicators).

parameters.indicator: Design.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has continuous interaction features that allow Child users to access content without a clear stopping point (e.g., infinite scroll, swipe, autoplay next).

parameters.indicator: Application of technology.
parameters.technical_configuration: Social metric features, including the display of the number of likes, comments, shares, views, or reactions.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF displays social metrics (e.g., like, share, view count, and similar metrics) on content uploaded by Child users.

parameters.indicator: Application of technology.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has push notification features, email, and/or pop-ups that encourage Child users to use the PLF.

parameters.indicator: Design.
parameters.technical_configuration: Elements of chance, lotteries, and/or gambling.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF contains elements of chance (lotteries) and/or gambling directed at Child users.

parameters.indicator: Application of technology.
parameters.technical_configuration: Incentives or rewards, including discounts, vouchers, in-game rewards, exclusive features, or other forms.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF provides incentive/reward features (e.g., discounts, vouchers, in-game rewards, exclusive features) to Child users.

parameters.indicator: Application of technology.
parameters.technical_configuration: Competition mechanisms, including rankings, scores, or other forms.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has competition features (e.g., rankings, scores, leaderboards) that can be accessed by Child users.

parameters.indicator: Application of technology.
parameters.technical_configuration: Content that automatically disappears within a certain period of time.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has temporary content features (e.g., stories) that automatically disappear without a saving option for Child users.

parameters.indicator: Design.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has a game design that imposes consequences for mistakes and includes progressive or high levels of difficulty.

parameters.indicator: Design.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has checkpoint features and/or progress-saving (save progress) mechanisms within its game design.

parameters.indicator: Design.
parameters.technical_configuration: User flow design and mechanisms for stopping/completing activities.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has clear objectives and/or end points (end goals) within Child user accounts.

parameters.indicator: Excessive and/or increasingly intensive use of the PLF.
parameters.technical_configuration: Social metric features, including the display of likes, comments, shares, views, or reactions.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF displays the number of responses and the content of comments from other users on Child users' content.

parameters.indicator: Exposure to pornographic, violent, safety-harmful, and other content not appropriate for Children.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF displays content containing frightening visuals, violence, deep sadness, dramatic music, and/or shock effects (jump scare) to Child users.

parameters.indicator: Excessive and/or increasingly intensive use of the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF allows Child users to access services without clear time limitations.

parameters.indicator: Excessive and/or increasingly intensive use of the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has push notification features that notify Child users of other users' activities.

parameters.indicator: Excessive and/or increasingly intensive use of the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has filter features that modify the visual and/or audio appearance of Child users (e.g., beauty filters or voice changers).

parameters.indicator: Exposure to inappropriate content, and targeting Children for the offering of goods or services.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has content recommendation features based on profiling of Child users' data and/or behavior.

parameters.indicator: Exposure to pornographic, violent, safety-harmful, and other content not appropriate for Children.
parameters.technical_configuration: Content that automatically disappears within a certain period of time.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has temporary content features with limited duration (e.g., stories, disappearing messages).

parameters.indicator: Processing of Personal Data that may threaten the security of Children's Personal Data and interaction/communication with unknown persons.
parameters.technical_configuration: Visibility settings for presence status, including 'active' and 'last seen' status.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF displays 'active' and/or 'last seen' status on Child user accounts on a continuous basis without an option to disable it.

parameters.indicator: Communicating or interacting with unknown persons.
parameters.technical_configuration: Direct messaging, open interaction, and accounts.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF provides features for blocking and reporting content or other users.

parameters.indicator: The physical condition or biological functions of children as a result of using the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF can be accessed continuously by child users without a clear time limit.
parameters.polarity_flag: Translation places the weight under NO/NOT FOUND, yet the parameter statement reads as a risk-when-present. Verify the YES/NO polarity against the authoritative Bahasa Indonesia text before filing.

parameters.indicator: The physical condition or biological functions of children as a result of using the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has notification features that are active during children's sleep hours.
parameters.polarity_flag: Translation places the weight under NO/NOT FOUND, yet the parameter statement reads as a risk-when-present. Verify the YES/NO polarity against the authoritative Bahasa Indonesia text before filing.

parameters.indicator: The physical condition or biological functions of children as a result of using the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF provides dark mode or night light features that are automatically activated based on local time for child users.

parameters.indicator: The physical condition or biological functions of children as a result of using the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has a default volume setting at a level that complies with safe hearing limits for children.

parameters.indicator: The physical condition or biological functions of children as a result of using the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has an autoplay feature for videos or other audiovisual content on the application's main feed.

parameters.indicator: The physical condition or biological functions of children as a result of using the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF provides single activities that are repetitive within a certain period (e.g., repeated tapping, repeated swipe gestures).

parameters.indicator: The physical condition or biological functions of children as a result of using the PLF.
parameters.technical_configuration: Challenge features, interactions, or content distribution.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF enables child users to perform actions that may cause injury or death, either to themselves or to others.

parameters.indicator: The physical condition or biological functions of children as a result of using the PLF.
parameters.assessment_parameter: The PLF has a maximum volume limit that is safe for child users (<=60 dB).
